purpose: Define the player-facing Graphics/Video settings behavior before runtime implementation, without bypassing ProjectGovernor or WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER authority registration.

authority_state.rule: This contract is preparatory only. Do not implement runtime settings until the authority files contain the approved graphics/settings doctrine.

preset_model.native_720p_floor_rule: Performance and Balanced stay at 1280x720 with 100% resolution scale for target-floor validation unless the owner explicitly changes the target.
preset_model.custom_transition_rule: Changing any individual quality group from a named preset changes the displayed preset to Custom without silently altering unrelated groups.

screen_layout.dirty_state_rule: Apply is enabled only when working values differ from the last applied values.
screen_layout.revert_rule: Revert restores the last applied values, not factory defaults.
screen_layout.restore_defaults_rule: Restore Defaults selects the project default candidate values but does not persist them until Apply.

resolution_change_confirmation.timeout_behavior: Revert to last confirmed display mode and resolution.

resolution_scale.warning: Values below 100% are a Custom user choice and must not be used to claim the native-720p target floor.

quality_behavior.apply_rule: Apply only the groups represented by the selected preset or Custom working state; do not invent hidden expensive quality overrides.
quality_behavior.cinematic_rule: Cinematic is a presentation preset for stronger hardware, not permission to blindly maximize every shadow, foliage or effects group.
quality_behavior.texture_rule: Texture quality must be evaluated against streaming-pool and resident-memory evidence, not source-file size alone.

visual_economy.goal: Maximize visible beauty per measured CPU/GPU/VRAM cost.
visual_economy.hero_quality_rule: Reduce hero quality only after measured recovery from the cheaper waste categories is insufficient.

persistence_contract.startup_rule: Load and validate persisted settings through the UGameUserSettings path before exposing them as the current UI state.
persistence_contract.invalid_value_rule: Clamp or replace unsupported persisted values with safe project defaults rather than applying undefined values.

accessibility_and_clarity.tooltip_rule: Explain likely cost category without promising an FPS gain.

static: preset names and quality-group mappings are deterministic
manual quality-group change transitions UI to Custom
Apply/Revert/Restore Defaults semantics do not overwrite each other
native-720p floor presets remain 100% resolution scale
no second persistence store is introduced
ue4_exact_head_when_runner_returns: apply and persist every named preset
target_device: streaming pool and resident texture memory
